name: Vector Calculus (Michael Corral)
goodFor: A concise multivariable calculus text (vectors, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, line and surface integrals) with 420 exercises and answers to selected ones.
attribution: "Michael Corral, Vector Calculus", linked to https://www.mecmath.net/, with the section named; "GNU Free Documentation License, Version 1.2", linked to https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/fdl-1.2.html; and, when the text shown was shortened or changed, a note that it was.

evidence.quote: The book is distributed under the terms of the GNU Free Documentation License, Version 1.2 .
This is a text on elementary multivariable calculus, designed for students who have completed courses in single-variable calculus.
There are 420 exercises in the book.
